phase: Reference Mode Recovery — Private Non-Financial Credit Stock and Flow
scientific_interpretation: credit_stock is the same-month sum of directly published ECB BSI end-of-period loan stocks for domestic NFCs (S.11) and households/NPISH (S.14/S.15), from MFIs excluding the NCB, all currencies combined.
credit_flow is the same-month sum of directly published ECB BSI financial transactions for those same two counterpart sectors.
The flow is not a first difference of the stock and is not interpreted as gross new-lending originations.
The aggregation intentionally excludes other financial sectors rather than using the broader non-MFI excluding general-government aggregate.

Promotion improves observed reference-mode coverage only. It does not activate the bank-credit balance-sheet loop or monetary-credit transmission loop, validate causal effects, or mutate the Accounting Spine.
